item.title: tommy needs a haircut
item.description: A series of ongoing live works centred on the world of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. This work began in March 2024 as a playful revisitation of a nostalgic game from my childhood. I employ the protagonist, Tommy, as the actor on my stage who performs in ways that are often more sensual than originally written in the game. By doing so, I amplify the complexities of human behaviour and social dynamics within the game environment as they reflect real-world ethical dilemmas fuelled with existentialism. Inspired by Lev Manovich’s notions of media remixability, I am interested in remixing not just aesthetics but also techniques, methods, and languages of different media. For the future of this project, I want to get into subtle alterations of the game world itself.
